svg.text: Pantry R35 — sanitized source excerpt
Cabinet elevation (printed page 3)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 3
Refrigerator left; the 12-in drawer-over-door base is directly beside it. Two larger drawer bases
follow, with two internal fillers.
printed page 3
Wall-side allowance + GE bay + separator: 3¼ + 37 + ¾ = 41 in
printed page 3
B1/B2/B3 cabinet boxes: 106½ in measured together; individual widths unknown
printed page 3
F1 and F2 between boxes: ¾ + ¾ = 1½ in
printed page 3
Total finished W1 run: 41 + 106½ + 1½ = 149 in
printed page 3
Cabinet seams are illustrative. At 63½ in clear depth, the GE family dimensions plus 2 in rear space
leave about 26¾ in to the opposite wall when closed, or about 11 in at the stated 90° door projection;
neither proves actual swing. GE's family bin-removal note calls for about 14¼ in at the freezer-side
wall, much more than the planned 3¼-in left-end allowance. Full-size operating and service checks are
required before fixing W1 or the divider.
Source family: r35-p03-elevation.svg · printed page 3 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
